 Live Streaming Link for Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri Tonight, October 26, 2026: Indosiar and Vidio Broadcast Schedule
 Watch the live stream of Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri in the BRI Super League via Indosiar and Vidio. Check the full schedule for tonight's match.
 By: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Editor: Nayla Savitri 
 | 
 Contributor: Keisya Anjani 
 October 26, 2026, 18:48 WITA · 5 min read 
 The match between Persija Jakarta and Persik Kediri in the 2026/2027 BRI Super League, Monday (10/26/2026). The match is scheduled to take place at 19:00 WIB and can be watched via Vidio live streaming. (Nadia: AI/Aktualita.co) 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co - The live streaming link for Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri has become a focal point for national football fans ahead of the seventh week of the 2026/2027 BRI Super League, Monday (10/26/2026) evening. The duel between the two teams nicknamed the "Macan" (Tigers) is scheduled to take place at the Jakarta International Stadium (JIS), North Jakarta. 
 The Persija vs Persik Kediri match will begin at 19:00 WIB (Western Indonesian Time) or 20:00 WITA (Central Indonesian Time) . Viewers can watch it via the Indosiar live broadcast or the Vidio live streaming service. 
 Advertisement 
 The meeting is an important match for Persija, who are trying to maintain their position at the top of the standings. Meanwhile, Persik arrives in Jakarta with the ambition to steal points and continue their positive momentum after winning their previous match. 
 Persija has the capital of a 5-1 landslide victory over Arema FC. On the other hand, Persik Kediri just defeated PSS Sleman with a score of 2-1. 
 With both teams currently feeling confident, the match at JIS is expected to present an interesting competition from the first minute. 
 Live Streaming Link for Persija vs Persik Kediri on Vidio 
 For supporters of both teams who cannot watch the match live at the stadium, the broadcast of Persija Jakarta facing Persik Kediri is available through the official competition broadcaster. 
 Here is the information for tonight's match: 
 Match: Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri 
 Competition: BRI Super League 2026/2027 
 Week: Seventh 
 Day/Date: Monday, October 26, 2026 
 Kick-off: 19:00 WIB / 20:00 WITA 
 Stadium: Jakarta International Stadium (JIS) 
 Television live broadcast: Indosiar 
 Official live streaming: Vidio 
 Official match link: 
 Watch Live Streaming of Persija Jakarta vs Persik Kediri on Vidio 
 To access the broadcast via Vidio, viewers can open the link using a mobile phone, laptop, or smart television device that supports the Vidio application. 
 Users may need to log in to an account and activate a subscription package according to the service terms. Meanwhile, the Indosiar broadcast can be an option for people who want to watch the match via television. 
 The schedule and availability of the broadcast are subject to change according to the policies of the competition organizer and the broadcaster. 
 Persija Jakarta Aims to Maintain Top of Standings 
 Persija enters this match with high confidence after showing sharpness in the front line when defeating Arema FC 5-1 last week. 
 That result brought Shin Tae-yong's team to collect 15 points from six matches and occupy the top position in the provisional standings . 
 A victory over Persik would be an important addition for the "Macan Kemayoran" to maintain distance from competitors at the top. 
 However, Shin Tae-yong does not consider the match against Persik an easy one. The South Korean coach believes the opponent's game organization is quite solid, especially in maintaining space between lines. 
 "Persik is a very good and solid team in maintaining the distance between lines," said Shin Tae-yong, as quoted from the official Persija website, Sunday (10/25/2026). 
 Persija also received positive news ahead of the match. Two players who were previously absent, Rizky Ridho and Kyohei Yoshino, have returned to join the team. 
 The presence of both provides additional options for Shin Tae-yong in determining the player composition. However, the decision on who will appear from the first minute still depends on readiness and tactical needs. 
 The support of The Jakmania at JIS is also expected to be additional energy for Persija to maintain positive results at home. 
 Persik Kediri Ready to Provide Resistance 
 Persik Kediri is not coming to Jakarta just to complete the match schedule. The team nicknamed the "Macan Putih" (White Tigers) has the capital of a 2-1 victory over PSS Sleman. 
 Ahead of the seventh week, Persik has collected 10 points from six matches and still has the opportunity to improve its position in the standings. 
 Persik coach, Marcos Reina, realizes the quality of Persija, which has a number of experienced players. However, he emphasized that his foster children are still targeting maximum results. 
 "The main target is to win, but if we can get one point, that is enough," said Marcos Reina, as quoted from the official ILeague website, Monday (10/26/2026). 
 Reina explained that player compactness is one of Persik's important assets in facing the pressure of the hosts. 
 He is also wary of the speed of Persija's counter-attacks, especially the movement of wing players who can create opportunities when the opponent loses possession. 
 Therefore, Persik needs to maintain a balance between attacking and defending so as not to give too much space to the Macan Kemayoran front line. 
 Head to Head Persija vs Persik Kediri 
 Looking at the meeting records of the two teams, Persija has a better record than Persik in the last few matches. 
 Based on ILeague match data, Persija defeated Persik Kediri 3-1 when the two teams met at Brawijaya Stadium on May 16, 2026. 
 Previously, Persija also won 3-1 in the match on November 20, 2025. Meanwhile, on April 19, 2025, the Macan Kemayoran managed to bring home a narrow 1-0 victory from Persik's headquarters. 
 These records show that Persija is quite consistent in achieving positive results when facing the Macan Putih. 
 However, the results of previous matches do not always reflect the strength of the two teams in the current season. 
 Persik is now handled by Marcos Reina, while Persija is under the direction of Shin Tae-yong. The difference in the tactical approach of the two coaches has the potential to present new dynamics in this meeting. 
 Tactical Duel of Shin Tae-yong and Marcos Reina 
 One of the interesting things about the Persija vs Persik match is how the two coaches set strategies to face the opponent's strength. 
 Persija has the potential to try to take the initiative to attack by utilizing supporter support and the speed of transition towards the Persik defense. 
 Conversely, the visiting team needs to maintain defensive discipline while looking for opportunities to create threats through organized attacks. 
 The effectiveness of finishing, midfield control, and the ability to anticipate counter-attacks can be the deciding factors for the match result. 
 For Persija, the addition of three points is very meaningful to maintain the competition at the top of the standings. Meanwhile, Persik needs a positive result to maintain the opportunity to compete with the top teams. 
 This match is one of three BRI Super League matches taking place on Monday night. The other two matches pit Persebaya Surabaya against Madura United and Bhayangkara Presisi Lampung FC against PSM Makassar. 
 Both matches are also scheduled to start at 19:00 WIB. 
 With major interests for each team, the duel between Persija Jakarta and Persik Kediri is worth waiting for. Football fans can follow the match via the Indosiar live broadcast and the Vidio platform starting at 19:00 WIB or 20:00 WITA.
